Third-party libraries bundled with this site
============================================

d3.min.js — D3.js v7.9.0
  Copyright 2010-2023 Mike Bostock
  ISC License — https://github.com/d3/d3/blob/main/LICENSE

dagre.min.js — Dagre v0.8.5
  Copyright (c) 2012-2014 Chris Pettitt
  MIT License — https://github.com/dagrejs/dagre/blob/master/LICENSE

Both are redistributed unmodified under their original licences, which permit
this. They are bundled rather than loaded from a CDN so that the site keeps
working if a CDN becomes unavailable.
